user_prompt:
What is the effect of high-dose calcium supplementation, compared with placebo or no
treatment, on preterm birth before 37 weeks' gestation, specifically in the dose-stratified
analysis (high-dose subgroup)? Do not include the non-dose-stratified version of this
outcome or the timing-stratified ("started to take calcium") version — those are separate
analyses in this review. Pool as a Risk Ratio (RR) using each trial's reported preterm
birth events and total randomized per arm. If a trial reports zero events in both arms,
treat it as not estimable and exclude it from pooling.
